title: Curcumol, a major terpenoid from Curcumae Rhizoma, attenuates human uterine leiomyoma cell development via the p38MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Yu, Yong-Hui; Zhang, Hao-Jun; Yang, Fang; Xu, Lin; Liu, Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄醇通过p38MAPK/NF-kappaB通路抑制子宫肌瘤细胞，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Uterine fibroids (UFs) are the most common benign tumors in women of reproductive age. Curcumae Rhizoma, the main essential oil component of which is curcumol, is widely used for the treatment of phymatosis in China due to its antitumor, anti-inflammatory, antithrombin, anti-tissue fibrosis and anti-oxygen pharmacological activities, but its potential for the treatment of UFs has not been evaluated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the effects and mechanisms of curcumol intervention in human uterine leiomyoma cells (UMCs). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Putative targets of curcumol intervention in UFs were identified using network pharmacology strategies. Molecular docking was performed to assess the binding affinity of curcumol to core targets. A concentration gradient of curcumol (0, 50, 100, 200, 300, 400 and 500 muM) or RU-486 (mifepristone, 0, 10, 20, 40, 50, and 100 muM) was applied to UMCs, and cell viability was detected by the CCK-8 assay. Cell apoptosis and cell cycle were examined by flow cytometry, and cell migration was assessed by a wound-healing assay. Additionally, the mRNA and protein expression levels of critical pathway components were evaluated by RT‒PCR and western blotting. Finally, the actions of curcumol on different tumor cell lines were summarized. RESULTS: Network pharmacology predicted 62 genes with roles in the treatment of UFs with curcumol, and MAPK14 (p38MAPK) displayed a higher interaction degree. GO enrichment and KEGG analyses revealed that the core genes were abundantly enriched in the MAPK signaling pathway. The molecular binding of curcumol to core targets was relatively stable. In UMCs, 200, 300 and 400 muM curcumol treatment for 24 h decreased cell viability compared with that in the control group, and the greatest effect was detected at 48 h and maintained until 72 h. Curcumol arrested cells in the G0/G1 phase and subsequently suppressed mitosis, promoted early apoptosis and reduced the degree of wound healing in a concentration-dependent manner in UMCs. Furthermore, 200 muM curcumol decreased the mRNA and protein expression of p38MAPK, the mRNA expression of NF-kappaB, and the protein expression of Ki-67 and increased the mRNA and protein expression of Caspase 9. Curcumol (300 and 400 muM) decreased the mRNA and protein expression of p38MAPK, NF-kappaB, and Ki-67 and increased the protein expression of Caspase 9 in UMCs. Curcumol was demonstrated to treat tumor cell lines, including breast cancer, ovarian cancer, lung cancer, gastric cancer, liver cancer and nasopharyngeal carcinoma, but its effects on benign tumors have not yet been reported. CONCLUSION: Curcumol suppresses cell proliferation and cell migration while arresting the cell cycle in the G0/G1 phase and inducing cell apoptosis in UMCs via a mechanism related to p38MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway regulation. Curcumol may be a potential therapeutic and preventive agent in the treatment of benign tumors such as UFs.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：子宫肌瘤（UFs）是育龄女性中最常见的良性肿瘤。莪术（Curcumae Rhizoma）的主要精油成分为莪术醇（curcumol），因其具有抗肿瘤、抗炎、抗凝血酶、抗组织纤维化和抗氧化等药理活性，在中国广泛用于治疗癥瘕，但其治疗子宫肌瘤的潜力尚未被评估。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨莪术醇干预人子宫平滑肌瘤细胞（UMCs）的作用及其机制。材料与方法：通过网络药理学策略鉴定莪术醇干预子宫肌瘤的推定靶点。进行分子对接以评估莪术醇与核心靶点的结合亲和力。将浓度梯度的莪术醇（0、50、100、200、300、400和500 μM）或RU-486（米非司酮，0、10、20、40、50和100 μM）应用于UMCs，并通过CCK-8法检测细胞活力。通过流式细胞术检测细胞凋亡和细胞周期，通过伤口愈合实验评估细胞迁移。此外，通过RT-PCR和western blotting评估关键通路组分的mRNA和蛋白表达水平。最后，总结了莪术醇对不同肿瘤细胞系的作用。结果：网络药理学预测了62个与莪术醇治疗子宫肌瘤相关的基因，其中MAPK14（p38MAPK）显示出较高的相互作用度。GO富集和KEGG分析显示，核心基因在MAPK信号通路中显著富集。莪术醇与核心靶点的分子结合相对稳定。在UMCs中，200、300和400 μM莪术醇处理24小时与对照组相比降低了细胞活力，且在48小时时效果最显著，并维持至72小时。莪术醇将细胞阻滞在G0/G1期，随后抑制有丝分裂，促进早期凋亡，并以浓度依赖性方式降低UMCs中的伤口愈合程度。此外，200 μM莪术醇降低了p38MAPK的mRNA和蛋白表达、NF-kappaB的mRNA表达以及Ki-67的蛋白表达，并增加了Caspase 9的mRNA和蛋白表达。莪术醇（300和400 μM）降低了UMCs中p38MAPK、NF-kappaB和Ki-67的mRNA和蛋白表达，并增加了Caspase 9的蛋白表达。莪术醇已被证明可治疗多种肿瘤细胞系，包括乳腺癌、卵巢癌、肺癌、胃癌、肝癌和鼻咽癌，但其对良性肿瘤的作用尚未见报道。结论：莪术醇通过抑制细胞增殖和细胞迁移，同时将细胞周期阻滞在G0/G1期并诱导细胞凋亡，其机制与p38MAPK/NF-kappaB通路调控相关。莪术醇可能成为治疗子宫肌瘤等良性肿瘤的潜在治疗和预防药物。
